purpose: Minimal raw gearbox loader acceptance set; no production algorithm or processed-subset replacement.
evidence_note: Source PDFs and intake notes live below data_root/raw_sources. Channel semantics follow source documentation; numeric file layout, scalars, first samples, byte sizes and hashes were checked locally on 2026-11-11.
limitations: HUST nominal speed/torque have four paired conditions, not a factorial design; only the 20 Hz/0.113 Nm pair is included.
HUST 8 acquisition blocks have block-local timestamps resetting every 32768 rows; continuity across blocks is unknown. Reader never joins blocks.
WT batch suffix 1 identifies the first documented collection/reinstallation series; it does not prove one unchanged physical installation across different sun gears.
Signal units and electrical speed/encoder calibration are unknown. No raw auxiliary channel is directly a rotation frequency.
The five original acquisitions support reader/diagnostic smoke tests, not independent generalization or class-performance claims.
